body: Tunnelling: no SweptCcd; keep avian's default unbounded speculative margin. Probe: a 4.1 m box at 28 m/s stops at a 0.5 m wall and a 45 deg corner with the default margin and even with SpeculativeMargin::ZERO (penetrates 0.36 m, pushed back). Alternative SweptCcd rejected (GDD 5.1: only on a failing gate). The tunnelling gate is flipped RED by breaking the car's collision layers, not by the margin.

Impact speed = (v1_pre - v2_pre).n with velocities recorded in FixedPostUpdate before PhysicsSystems::First (after Tnua motors) and the manifold normal from Collisions; processed next FixedUpdate in HealthSystems::Damage from CollisionStart. Probe: CollisionStart lands on the tick of the velocity jump, post-step closing speed is ~0. Alternative post-step velocities / contact impulse rejected.

Player in a car stays the same entity: Driving{vehicle} + RigidBodyDisabled + ColliderDisabled on body and head hitbox, seat sync after PhysicsSystems::Last. Alternative TnuaToggle::Disabled rejected: bevy-tnua-avian3d 0.12.1 apply_motors_system returns (not continues) on the first disabled entity (lib.rs:429-431), starving later characters of motors.

Parked cars: citygen ParkingSpot list on avenue curb lanes from its own ChaCha stream (tag 16), appended to the hash after player_spawn with HASH_SCHEMA_VERSION 2->3 and a 3-seed rebless, proven geometry-neutral by a run with parking generated but unhashed. Alternative streets/alleys rejected: 1-lane streets and 4.5 m alleys would be blocked for T15 traffic.

Car mass via ColliderDensity = mass / chassis volume (plus CenterOfMass override), not Mass(1200): avian 0.7 docs do not state that a Mass override rescales the collider's angular inertia; a gate checks ComputedMass and the yaw inertia against m/12(w^2+l^2).

Tnua motor-fix gate: the walker is moved into a table created AFTER the corpse table (test-only marker inserted on the player after the corpse exists) and the test asserts corpse-before-walker iteration order (GATE BROKEN otherwise). Rejected: 'spawn a corpse first, then walk any character' - bevy_ecs 0.19.1 iterates matched tables in creation order (query/state.rs matched_storage_ids push), so a walker whose table predates the corpse table stays GREEN under the `return` bug.

Q2 bullets vs car: combat writes a new `BulletHitVehicle` message (hit collider's memberships contain GameLayer::Vehicle, base damage x falloff, no RNG draw); the vehicle domain applies `damage.ron vehicle.bullet_scale` to VehicleHealth. Rejected: giving the car `Health` (every Health consumer - Dead insertion, perception Hurt, crimes, HUD - would treat it as a person) and reading vehicle damage.ron inside combat (one owner per config, GDD 12).

Driver gets TnuaToggle::Disabled in addition to RigidBodyDisabled + ColliderDisabled once the vendored `return`->`continue` fix lands. Rejected: the planner's 'avoid TnuaToggle' (its only reason was the motor bug); without the toggle the seated driver's ground sensor (filter excludes only the owner, Character layer interacts with Vehicle) casts from inside the chassis every tick.

G12(c) fixture from PLAN_V2 (dummy on a 3 m block at (-25,0,8)) rejected: shot elevation 19.3 deg < 29.06 deg needed to enter the head sphere above the roof, so the head-ColliderDisabled flip can never go RED.

G12(c) shooter on a 3 m platform 1.25 m from the car side (elevation ~55 deg, 1 deg spread still enters the head at y>=2.16 > roof 2.08) instead of shooting straight down or horizontally at y 2.17 (horizontal leaves 0.04-0.09 m margins and misses the car in the baseline).

G3(f) latched-fire row uses an SMG with fire_held plus Enter.before(HealthSystems::Damage), instead of V2's pistol + fire_held (SemiAutomatic ignores fire_held, flip vacuous) with undefined enter/fire order.

Tnua gate precondition uses a QueryState created before the corpse (incremental archetype matching, like the motor system) instead of a fresh world.query: with required components bevy 0.19.1 matches a fresh query via the component index HashMap, so the plan's 'creation order' claim is false for one-batch matching and the fresh-query precondition went GATE BROKEN after Character gained required components. Alternative (fresh world.query) rejected.

G4 gates the FIRST hit's DamageDealt against the formula, not total health loss: a car that keeps rolling re-hits the knocked-down body (Tnua brakes it at ~45 m/s^2), so 6 m/s gave 36+12. Alternative (per-pair hit cooldown, new tuning value) rejected as unplanned mechanics; re-hits reported to the owner.

Roll influence applied as point = contact + up*(1 - roll_influence)*h (lever = roll_influence*h = 0.198 m, the plan's worked number); the plan's formula text '(roll_influence - 1)' is a sign typo that would put the lever at 1.7h.
Exit feet ray filters [World, Vehicle] instead of World only: the roof candidate must land on the roof, a World-only ray lands under the car and the capsule check rejects it.

G6 stall row drives in reverse (away from the wall) instead of forward: forward into the wall stays <0.1 m even without the stall rule (vacuous). G8b cop placed 1.25 m from the seat (arrest distance 1.5) instead of 1 m from the car front (3.5 m from the seat, vacuous: flip stayed GREEN). G11 theft row re-enters after incident_memory: the incident dedupe alone kept the first-flag flip GREEN.

G11 sidewalk fixture moved to x 20..40 (20x0.15x20 CityBlock) and the witness cop is the bare sight fixture of wanted_support::spawn_cop instead of police_support::spawn_unit: the plan's (-25,-20) block collides with the ramp/box fixtures for the off-block row, and a real unit at 0 stars leaves.

Golden rebless verified by rebuilding the new citygen with the pre-task hash.rs (schema 2) against the pre-task golden file (GREEN), instead of trusting the implementer's (a)-(d) narrative or editing project files for a flip.

Item 4: sight_blocked now uses [World, Vehicle] but skips any car that contains either end of the line (point_intersections + cast_ray_predicate). Rejected alternative: adding Vehicle to the mask verbatim, because the seated driver's eye (car centre + 0.75, half height 0.92) and the perception Car-threat target (car centre) lie inside a car box, so cops would never see a driver and ThreatKind::Car would never fire.

Item 2: damper on d(compression)/dt from the previous tick's WheelState, rate 0 on the first grounded tick. Rejected alternative: the review's literal (compression - previous)/dt with previous = default 0, which kicks a freshly spawned car up at 0.83 m/s (measured by the new spawn-kick row in G5).

Cars in every sight_blocked caller, movement included: t11 seed 1 left a Patrol stuck in Respond at 43.7 m for 11.3 s (HEAD sight: that cop arrived in 6.6 s). Police dest_clear turned false behind a parked car and the direct seek never resumed.

Split the line test: sight_blocked (World + Vehicle, a car holding an end is skipped) for seeing and shooting (perception, gang sees, cop_sees/witnesses, tactics fire_line spot check); wall_blocked (World only, the old rule) for movement and spawn cover (navigation avoid_offset, police dest_clear, gang home_clear, population). Rejected: one rule for all callers (the t11 stall above). t11 rerun: arrest 6.5 s / 9.9 s reach, no stuck cop.

Curb bug: the fix is the chassis collider (convex hull, bottom raised 0.2 m, nose and tail chamfer 0.5 x 0.3 m, in sedan.ron underbody) plus a scrape rule (damage.ron vehicle.scrape_normal 0.5: a contact normal within 60 deg of the car's down axis is not a crash). Rejected: the rule alone (the car is still caught at 0.92 m/s, 0 damage) and the chamfer alone (still 118..376 damage). Lift alone already clears; the chamfer is margin for nose dive and taller steps.

max_damper_speed = 0.5 m/s (clamp both ways). Measured caps 100/1.0/0.5/0.3 on the curb at 10/20/28 m/s: peak 28.4k/9.3k/8.2k/7.8k N, max hop vy 1.23/0.84/0.99/1.11 m/s. Chose 0.5 over 1.0 (lowest hop) because the orchestrator target is ~7 kN and 0.5 equals the G5 drop rate, so the settle dynamics are bit-identical; over 0.3 because lower caps under-damp the rebound.

Exit candidates carry an expected feet height: doors = car ground (centre - up*rest_height), roof = car top (centre + up*hy); tolerance = float_height - capsule_height/2 (0.3 m, the capsule clearance the float spring steps over, no new const). Kept the roof candidate (it is the car, not an obstacle) instead of dropping it; an overhang above the roof is rejected by the same rule. Alternative rejected: casting the feet ray from door height (a 1 m wall below that start would still be stood on).

Runtime curb probe at parked spot -15 m along the lane hit an intersection, not a curb: square rows peaked at 3.3 kN (static load) and never rose to sidewalk height. Only rows with a wheel force peak near 8 kN and centre y rising by 0.15 m count as curb evidence; the spot +12 m rows were used.

Busted while driving was not forced at runtime: NextState<GameState> is not reflected over BRP and no production path reaches Busted in a car (arrest excludes Driving). Relied on headless busted_while_driving_ejects_and_respawns_at_the_station instead of adding a debug hook.

t13.py regression verified with a scratch copy that only appends Engine to CLASSES and a cap of 1 (exit 0), instead of editing tools/qa/scenarios/t13.py in QA: the fix belongs to the fixer, the copy proves the rest of t13 is green.

B1: t13 class names parsed from SoundClass enum in cues.rs, caps from mix.ron voices + siren.max_emitters + LOOP_CAPS law table (Ambience 2, Engine 1); alternative (QA recipe: append Engine to static lists) rejected, repeats the desync. B2: sphere cast seat->candidate vs World|Vehicle excluding own car; alternative ray cast rejected (misses fence edges a capsule-wide body would hit).
